invariants.rationale: The method returns a non-null list, as Collectors.toList() never returns null.
Each element V in the result list must be non-null; nulls cannot result from the reduction pipeline.
The number of values in the result list cannot exceed the number of input elements since each input contributes at most one group.
A list’s size is always non-negative.
Parallelism should be greater than zero to ensure the stream can be executed in parallel as expected.
